VIDEO PROJECTS BO'LIM MUQOVASI (85-bet, PDF 73). Och pushti fon, chapda kinoproyektor rasmi, to'q sariq 'Video Projects' sarlavhasi. Och ko'k ramka ichida matn:
'The films below are to be seen after the relevant units have been taught. They are as follows:'
Unit 2 Anastasia (93')
Unit 7 The Man in the Iron Mask (132')
Unit 8 The Mask of Zorro (137')
Unit 11 Armageddon (145')
Unit 14 Dr Dolittle (85')
'Video cassettes of the above films can be found in your local video shops, or ordered through the Internet via: http/www. Blockbusters. com'

⚠ 84-bet (Progress Test 8 orqasi) bo'sh - skanda yo'q. Mundarija: 'Video Projects p. 85' - mos.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '85'.

exercises.instructionEn: The films below are to be seen after the relevant units have been taught. They are as follows:
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi filmlar tegishli unitlar o'tilgandan keyin ko'riladi. Ular quyidagilar:
exercises.explanationUz:
VIDEO LOYIHALAR - BO'LIM MUQOVASI.

  Workbook oxirida 5 ta film uchun
  ish varaqlari bor. Har film
  ma'lum unitdan KEYIN ko'riladi:

     Unit 2  - Anastasia (93 daqiqa)
     Unit 7  - The Man in the Iron
               Mask (132 daqiqa)
     Unit 8  - The Mask of Zorro
               (137 daqiqa)
     Unit 11 - Armageddon (145
               daqiqa)
     Unit 14 - Dr Dolittle (85
               daqiqa)

  Qavsdagi son (93') = filmning
  davomiyligi daqiqalarda.


NIMA UChUN:

  Film unit mavzusiga bog'liq:
    Anastasia - 2-unit (Night and
      Day - kundalik hayot,
      o'tmish)
    The Man in the Iron Mask -
      7-unit (Profiles - tarixiy
      shaxslar)
    The Mask of Zorro - 8-unit (A
      Brush with Danger - xavf)
    Armageddon - 11-unit (Our
      Precious Planet - sayyora)
    Dr Dolittle - 14-unit (Live and
      Let Live - hayvonlar)


QAYERDAN TOPISh:

  'Video cassettes ... can be found
  in your local video shops, or
  ordered through the Internet' -
  kitob 2000-yillar boshida
  chiqqan, shuning uchun
  videokasseta va Blockbuster
  haqida gap boradi. Hozir bu
  filmlarni onlayn topish mumkin.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  relevant   = tegishli
  to be taught = o'qitilmoq
  as follows = quyidagicha
  a video cassette = videokasseta
  local      = mahalliy
  to order   = buyurtma qilmoq
  via        = orqali

points.noteUz: Tarixiy sarguzasht: Fransiya qiroli va uning egizagi.
Komediya: hayvonlar bilan gaplasha oladigan shifokor.

points.en: Video cassettes of the above films can be found in your local video shops, or ordered through the Internet via: http/www.Blockbusters.com
points.uz: Yuqoridagi filmlarning videokassetalarini mahalliy video do'konlaridan topish yoki internet orqali buyurtma qilish mumkin: http/www.Blockbusters.com
points.noteUz: ⚠ 'can be found' / '(can be) ordered' - majhul nisbat.

5 TA FILM - 5 TA UNIT.

  2 → Anastasia
  7 → The Man in the Iron Mask
  8 → The Mask of Zorro
  11 → Armageddon
  14 → Dr Dolittle
